description: Get every bookmaker's fixed-odds win and place prices for every runner in one race, the best win and place price, and Betfair Exchange back and lay prices with the money available and matched. Scratched runners are marked. Needs a paid plan or the Pro trial; about 1 credit per 10 bookmakers.

bookmakers.description: Optional comma separated bookmaker keys, at most 20, for example tab,sportsbet,betfair_exchange

race_id.description: Race ID from list_races, for example thoroughbred_2026-11-19_AUS_kestrel_downs_r3

name: race_odds
title: Race odds
